answer: Agents fund a crystal voucher each epoch by burning 0.07g azure ore mined from a monitored falcon-guarded orchard. Each gram must age in an open-air cage for 4.3 days, measured by oxygen diffusion through a calibrated lattice; a Sybil farm must secure fresh ore and repeat the ageing cycle per head, since artificial diffusion cannot mimic the orchard’s seasonal micro-climate signature without detectable oxygen isotope drift.
